newsitem.title: FINLAND: POSTIPANKKI SAYS BANKWATCH UPS RATING TO C.
newsitem.headline: POSTIPANKKI SAYS BANKWATCH UPS RATING TO C.

text.p: Finnish state-owned commercial bank group Postipankki Oy said in a statement on Wednesday that U.S. rating agency BankWatch had raised its risk rating to C from C/D.
The move was the first by BankWatch for Postipankki since November 1992, when the risk rating fell to C/D from C, Postipankki said.
Postipankki's favourable earnings trend and satisfactory capital adequacy were the reason for the improved rating, it said.
On Tuesday, Finnish commercial bank group Merita Oy said BankWatch had raised its risk rating to C from C/D. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
